Schnittstelle Pred2<A1,A2>

Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first argument
A2 - the type of the second argument
Alle Superschnittstellen:
BiPredicate<A1,A2>, Deferrable2<A1,A2,Boolean>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Pred2<A1,A2> extends Deferrable2<A1,A2,Boolean>, BiPredicate<A1,A2>

A binary predicate f: A1 × A2 → {true, false}.

Contract: inputs must not be null. Combinators use short‑circuit evaluation where applicable (e.g., and, or, implies).

Seit:
1.0.0

      static <A1,A2> Pred2<A1,A2> pred2(@NonNull BiPredicate<? super A1, ? super A2> biPredicate)

      Wraps the given BiPredicate into a Pred2.

      Contract: biPredicate must not be null.

      Typparameter:

      A2 - the second argument type

      biPredicate - the predicate to wrap; must not be null

    • and

      default @NonNull Pred2<A1,A2> and(@NonNull Pred2<A1,A2> other)

      Returns the logical conjunction of this predicate and other. Short‑circuits: other is evaluated only if this.test(a1, a2) is true.

      Parameter:
      other - the predicate to combine with; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a predicate representing this AND other
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if other is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

      Logical conjunction with a BooleanSupplier. Short‑circuits: the supplier is invoked only if this.test(a1, a2) is true.

      Parameter:
